name: Sample Order & Product Generator
author: Douple

sections.description:
Sample Order & Product Generator helps developers, testers, and store owners create dummy WooCommerce orders and simple products for testing plugins, themes, reports, and demos.

Features

  • Generate sample orders with chosen status and products per order
  • Supports completed, processing, pending, and on-hold statuses
  • Generate simple sample products (up to 10 per run)
  • Sample data is clearly marked with plugin meta
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Clean admin interface
  • Fully translatable

A separate advanced toolkit (scheduling, variable products, CSV exports, presets, and cleanup tools) is available as a separately distributed plugin: https://douple.net/sample-order-product-generator/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/douple-sample-order-generator, or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin (requires WooCommerce).
  3. Open Sample Orders in the admin menu to generate sample orders or products.
sections.faq:
Will it delete or modify real orders?

No. This plugin only creates new sample orders and products. It does not modify existing customer data.

Are any features locked behind a licence?

No. Everything included in this plugin works without payment or activation.

Does this plugin send data to third parties?

No. Sample order and product data stays in your WordPress database. This package does not contact external services.

Where is the source code?

https://github.com/thiendo/WordPress-Sample-Order-Product-Generator-Plugin

  • Renamed to Sample Order & Product Generator for WordPress.org.

  • Removed upgrade / trialware UI from the free package (Guideline 5).

1.2.0

  • Packaging improvements and HPOS compatibility.
  • Free package focuses on fully usable sample order and product tools.

1.0

  • Initial release with core features: generate multiple sample orders, choose order status, and items per order.
